evals.prompt: Perform an architectural design smell audit on the storage and engine modules. Identify any cyclic dependencies, leaky encapsulation, or multifaceted abstractions, and prescribe canonical architectural remedies without modifying code.
evals.expected_output: A structured Design Smell Diagnostic categorizing symptoms under Abstraction, Encapsulation, Modularization, or Hierarchy, citing structural evidence, and prescribing concrete architectural remedies.
expectations: Identifies and categorizes smells under the four canonical design smell pillars
Cites concrete structural evidence such as module import cycles, file sizes, or public exposure of internals
Pairs each smell with an actionable architectural remedy (e.g., Dependency Inversion, Encapsulate Boundary)
Separates macro design smells from routine micro-level syntax cleanup
prohibitions: Do not modify production code or tests directly
Do not reduce the audit to localized variable naming or formatting nits
Do not recommend speculative abstraction hierarchies without demonstrated variance
